caption_lines: GALVESTON, TEXAS - WHARF FRONT AND DOWNTOWN, 1912
Avenue A (Water) to Avenue I (Sealy) - 19th Street to 25th Street (Rosenberg Avenue) - Piers 19-25

Composited from 14 source regions of the 1912 Sanborn Fire Insurance Map (LOC sanborn08539_004); sheets 5(A,B),7,8,9,10,11,12,39,40,43,44,49,50; original colors retained; plate disagreements preserved; wharf plates (100 ft/in) unified to the grid scale of 50 ft/in - printed at approx. 80 ft/in.
